description: Protein-mean decomposition of the matched canonical residue-LeJEPA A/B EMA 10k latent caches

definitions.protein_mean: mean of all cached real-residue embeddings in each protein
definitions.residual: raw residue embedding minus its protein mean
definitions.neighbours: cosine 10-NN in the component space, excluding residues from the query protein
definitions.variance_fraction: sum of component coordinate variances divided by the sum for raw z, evaluated on the frozen residue sample
